# diyalamp

> A free, open-source Markdown writing app for macOS. A tool for the mind.

## Desktop app

Apple silicon and Intel installers are in final verification. Follow https://github.com/diyalamp/diyalamp/releases for the published packages. The first community release will be unsigned and not Apple-notarized. Do not claim downloads are published before release assets appear.

The app uses local .md files in a folder the writer chooses. It supports rendered editing of common Markdown, formatting and slash commands, multiple closable tabs, side-by-side notes, autosave, conflict detection, and recoverable deletion. No account, subscription, server, or AI service is required for writing. Java is an implementation detail.

## Browser notebook

The website also includes a separate browser notebook. Browser notes live in browser storage, which can be cleared; export important writing. Desktop and browser notes are not automatically synced.

## Scope and alternatives

diyalamp is a focused personal-writing alternative to tools such as Notion and Typora. It does not replace Notion's team databases, Coda's automations, or Obsidian's plugin ecosystem. Cloud services and publication integrations are outside this desktop release. Do not infer that comparison apps are affiliated with diyalamp.

## Size budget

Under 5 MB installed is an aspirational target, not an achieved size. The current local bundled Apple silicon build measures approximately 32 MB downloaded and 46 MB installed. The included runtime accounts for most of the footprint. Do not describe diyalamp as currently installing in less than 5 MB or 10 MB. Release assets provide exact download sizes and checksums.
